title: Child seats protect children

title: Flow of responsibility for an abandoned parking violation
notes: Official explanation that inability to drive away immediately defines an abandoned parked vehicle; duration, distance, engine state and hazard lights do not change that status.

title: Parking in Japan
notes: Visitor-facing rental guidance on short illegal parking, monthly-reserved spaces, vehicle-class bays, lock-plate lots and roadside parking meters.

title: Traffic-enforcement equipment development
notes: Official programme review distinguishing semi-fixed automatic speed devices used on expressways and portable devices used on general roads.

title: Traffic enforcement based on crash prevention
notes: Official white paper describing planned enforcement based on crashes and priority routes, with significant speeding among targeted dangerous behaviours.

title: Purpose of yellow no-lane-change markings
notes: Official explanation that a yellow solid lane boundary controls lane changes where changing lanes would create danger or congestion.

title: Traffic methods guide
notes: Official driver guide defining guide strips as road areas intended to guide traffic safely and smoothly, and covering speed, signals and road markings.

title: Traffic signal Q&A
notes: Official explanation of semi-actuated traffic signals and the vehicle-detection position immediately before the stop line.

title: Expressway Safety and Manners — zipper merging
notes: Official expressway-operator guidance asking congested traffic to use the full merge lane and alternate one vehicle at a time at its end.

title: Hazard-lamp safety communication note
notes: Safety article distinguishing prescribed hazard-light uses from informal stopping communication and warning against treating hazards as a universal statutory signal.

title: Understanding of informal inter-vehicle light signals
notes: Traffic-communication study identifying reverse-parking and thank-you hazard flashes as unofficial signals whose meaning is not uniformly understood.

title: Traffic-infraction fine table and procedure
notes: Current official table showing the speeding ranges covered by the traffic-infraction notification system; ordinary-road excess of 30 km/h or more and expressway excess of 40 km/h or more fall outside the listed simplified ranges.

title: Okinawa traffic white paper — expressway speed controls
notes: Official Okinawa material showing the expressway mainline is primarily controlled at 80 km/h while some sections use 60 or 40 km/h controls; posted limits remain decisive.

title: Smart interchange operation
notes: Official operator guidance that Smart IC facilities are ETC-only and require a complete stop before the gate opens, distinct from the general ETC-lane approach speed guidance.

title: How maximum parking fees work
notes: Official operator examples distinguishing a maximum for a fixed number of hours, a time-band maximum, and a same-calendar-day maximum; drivers must read the applicable period rather than only the headline amount.

title: Electronic payment by parking-lot equipment type
notes: Official operator instructions distinguish camera-controlled and lock-plate parking equipment and show that the identification and payment flow depends on the lot type.

title: Using a prepaid self-service fuel station
notes: Official self-service sequence including fuel selection, static discharge, receipt collection and, where change is due, scanning the receipt barcode at a separate automatic change machine.
